run.question:
We have an active P1 incident — the checkout service in our production-us-east-2
cluster is throwing 500 errors and customers cannot complete payments. Please
investigate the root cause using the app-260-prod-logs index.

report.summary: The named cluster is present in the data: the app-260-prod-logs index holds 10 documents inside the authorized window, 8 of them with cluster=production-us-east-2/region=us-east-2 (2 more carry cluster=production-eu-west-2 and are a different cluster). In production-us-east-2 the checkout-service 500s are preceded and explained by payment-service failures against its external card provider: at 2026-11-22T06:41:40Z checkout-service already warned p95=1700ms against an 800ms target; at 07:41:40Z the same correlation_id chk-us-2142 appears on checkout-service 'payment provider response timeout after 30s (provider=stripe-us)' (500) and on payment-service 'Upstream timeout calling stripe-us /v1/charges after 30000ms' (504); further 504s to stripe-us/us-east-2 appear at 08:56:40Z, a 502 from the provider at 09:11:40Z, and at 09:26:40Z payment-service acknowledged 'Stripe-US degraded mode' with retry queue depth=1031. checkout-service then rejected calls with 'circuit-breaker open for payment-service (failure rate 41% > 25% threshold)' at 08:41:40Z and 09:36:40Z. The deepest supported cause is therefore the external payment provider stripe-us, with payment-service and checkout-service failures as its mechanism/consequence. Prometheus and Jaeger were unreachable (SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE on both attempts), and Kubernetes access is the production-eu-west-2 cluster only, so no us-east-2 metrics, traces, pods or configs could be checked; the incident volume (how many checkout attempts/customers failed) is unknown because only 10 log documents exist in 24 hours. In the reachable production-eu-west-2 cluster the otel-demo checkout and payment pods were Running/Ready and their sampled logs show successful charges in the same window, which is a different cluster and not evidence about the us-east-2 pods.

claims.text: app-260-prod-logs maps cluster, region, service, level, status_code, message, correlation_id and timestamp, and held 10 documents in the authorized window: 8 with cluster=production-us-east-2/region=us-east-2 and 2 with cluster=production-eu-west-2/region=eu-west-2.
Earliest document in the window, 2026-11-22T06:41:40Z, is checkout-service (production-us-east-2) WARN 'Latency on POST /api/checkout p95=1700ms (target 800ms)', correlation_id chk-us-2001.

At 2026-11-22T07:41:40Z the same correlation_id chk-us-2142 appears on two production-us-east-2 documents: checkout-service ERROR 500 'POST /api/checkout failed: payment provider response timeout after 30s (provider=stripe-us)' and payment-service ERROR 504 'Upstream timeout calling stripe-us /v1/charges after 30000ms'.

At 2026-11-22T08:41:40Z checkout-service (production-us-east-2) logged ERROR 500 'POST /api/checkout failed: circuit-breaker open for payment-service (failure rate 41% > 25% threshold)' (chk-us-2208).
At 2026-11-22T08:56:40Z payment-service (production-us-east-2) logged ERROR 504 'Upstream timeout calling stripe-us /v1/charges after 30000ms' with correlation_id chk-us-2220.
At 2026-11-22T09:11:40Z checkout-service (production-us-east-2) logged ERROR 500 'POST /api/checkout failed: payment provider returned 502 Bad Gateway' with correlation_id chk-us-2252.
At 2026-11-22T09:26:40Z payment-service (production-us-east-2) logged WARN 'Stripe-US degraded mode acknowledged via status page; retry queue depth=1031' with status_code 200.
At 2026-11-22T09:36:40Z checkout-service (production-us-east-2) logged ERROR 500 'POST /api/checkout failed: circuit-breaker open for payment-service' (chk-us-2280).

The two production-eu-west-2 documents (a different cluster from the incident) report checkout-service healthy ('Healthy: p95 latency 230ms over last 5 minutes', 07:41:40Z) and payment-service 'Stripe-EU responding normally, p95 latency 180ms' (08:41:40Z).

In the Kubernetes cluster reachable in this Run (production-eu-west-2 per the Run's access scope; the single node opspilot-m1-control-plane carries no topology region label), pods otel-demo/checkout-6578865d87-5zx6n and otel-demo/payment-6f7bc865d6-9z92d were Running/Ready with restartCount 2.

Those production-eu-west-2 pods' logs between 2026-11-22T09:34:36Z and 09:40:45Z show successful charges: payment logs 'Charge request received.' followed by 'Transaction complete.', and checkout logs 'payment went through (transaction_id: ...)' and 'order confirmation email sent'.

Kubernetes events in the authorized window numbered 14: namespace app-100a Deployment ScalingReplicaSet x2, Pod Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started x2 each, ReplicaSet SuccessfulCreate x2 (loki and payment-api-100a startup), plus 2 Warning Endpoints FailedToCreateEndpoint in namespace default for objects orca and signup-service ('endpoints already exists'). None of these events involves checkout-service or payment-service in production-us-east-2.

The origin of the production-us-east-2 checkout failures is the external payment provider stripe-us: its /v1/charges calls exceeded the 30s timeout at 07:41:40Z and 08:56:40Z and returned 502 at 09:11:40Z, payment-service consequently returned 504s and entered a degraded retry state (queue depth=1031), and checkout-service converted that into 500s via provider timeouts and an open circuit breaker. The retry-queue depth is a consequence that may prolong recovery, not shown to be an independent cause.

A checkout-service internal defect as the origin is rejected: every checkout-service 500 in the index attributes the failure to the payment provider (response timeout after 30s, provider=stripe-us; 502 Bad Gateway) or to the circuit breaker opened for payment-service, with no checkout-internal error message.

A global Stripe outage is rejected: in the same index, production-eu-west-2 payment-service reported 'Stripe-EU responding normally, p95 latency 180ms' at 08:41:40Z while production-us-east-2 was timing out against stripe-us, so the provider evidence is region-specific, not global.

The reachable production-eu-west-2 checkout/payment pods (checkout-6578865d87-5zx6n, payment-6f7bc865d6-9z92d) completed charges successfully in the same window, which weighs against a defect in shared checkout/payment application code; it says nothing about the production-us-east-2 pods, which were not checked.

Obtain stripe-us provider status/timeline and open a provider ticket for the /v1/charges timeouts and 502s seen from 07:41:40Z onward; meanwhile monitor payment-service retry-queue depth and checkout-service circuit-breaker state, and confirm the payment-service 504 rate and checkout 500 rate once Prometheus/Jaeger data for production-us-east-2 is reachable.

gaps: Prometheus returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE on both attempts (get_all_labels at 09:42:16Z and 09:42:05Z), so no metric series (e.g. traces_span_metrics_calls_total, rpc_* duration/status) were readable and no error-rate or latency baseline for production-us-east-2 exists.

Jaeger returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE for traces_list_services (09:42:05Z) and traces_search (09:42:16Z), so no traces of checkout-service or payment-service in production-us-east-2 could be examined and no parent-child call edges were verified.

Kubernetes access in this Run is the production-eu-west-2 cluster only; the production-us-east-2 checkout-service and payment-service pods, their last termination reasons, their ConfigMaps/settings and any deploys were not readable.

app-260-prod-logs is extremely sparse (10 documents in the whole authorized window, none between 09:36:40Z and the window end), so the number of failed checkouts, the share of requests affected and whether failures continued after 09:36:40Z are unknown; the index may be sampled.

The statement that Stripe-US was in 'degraded mode' comes only from a payment-service log; the provider's own status page/incident record could not be read, so the external fault itself and its start time were not observed directly.
The change_history integration is not integrated in this Run, so recent deploys or configuration changes in production-us-east-2 cannot be correlated with the 06:41:40Z latency onset.

The Warning Endpoints FailedToCreateEndpoint events name services orca (namespace app-95) and signup-service (namespace app-162) in namespace default; those namespaces/objects are absent from the readable pod list and their objects were not read, so any link to this incident is unknown.

Error-filtered log queries against the production-eu-west-2 otel-demo checkout and payment pods returned status no_data (no matching lines), which cannot support a health claim either way; only sampled lines were read.
No topology region/zone label exists on the reachable node, so the production-eu-west-2 identity of the Kubernetes data rests on the Run's access scope, not on an in-data cluster field.
next_steps: Read production-us-east-2 payment-service and checkout-service pod status, container last termination reasons and logs, and their ConfigMaps, once Kubernetes access to that cluster is available.
Query production-us-east-2 error-rate and latency series (checkout 500 rate, payment-service gRPC status codes, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds for the stripe-us client) and a pre-incident baseline.
Review the provider (stripe-us) incident timeline and payment-service retry-queue depth trend to decide whether to drain the queue or keep the circuit breaker engaged.
Confirm with the payments team whether the circuit-breaker threshold (25%) and 30s provider timeout are intended for this provider's current latency.
